references.text: Describes the tribal inheritance of Asher, including the cities Acco, Sidon, Achlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphek and Rehob mentioned in Judges 1:31
Specifically mentions Sidon and Rehob as cities within Asher's inheritance
Mentions Sidon as a border of the land that remained to be taken
Mentions the Sidonians as one of the peoples left to test Israel
Refers to Sidon and Rehob in connection with the settlement of the tribe of Dan
Mentions great Sidon as part of Israel's promised border
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun mentions that his border shall reach to Sidon
